decisions.reason: The shared 7 cm and 17 cm block-pareo border measurements are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The 7 cm and 17 cm measurements apply to the block-colour pareos, not the zebra print; the zebra-specific changes from this message are already separately represented.
The block-pareo border measurements do not alter the basket-weave requirement; its no-border treatment from the same message is already separately represented.
Retaining the block-pareo border measurements does not change the general print-ready file preparation requirements.
The 7 cm and 17 cm values are block-pareo border options rather than overall artwork dimensions; the independently stated 1.5 cm seam allowance is already represented.
The block-pareo border measurements do not change the technical sheet's colour-reference documentation requirement.
